summary: Summit Therapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on September 15, 2026, disclosing a press release with updated overall survival data from the global Phase III HARMONi trial of ivonescimab plus chemotherapy in EGFR-mutated NSCLC, presented at WCLC 2026 in Seoul; partner Akeso presented HARMONi-2 data. No corporate transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory mechanics are stated. This is an ordinary clinical-data current report, not a special situation; no deal terms apply. Watch pipeline and regulatory catalysts, not arbitrage.
